description: Prepare a viewing or question request when the person wants ChatGPT to help submit it in the conversation. Use one exact previously returned individual property reference, never a project summary. Creates no enquiry and sends no contacts. Rechecks the current public property and returns its receiving catalog team, the sharing disclosure and a 15-minute target-bound intent. Explain the disclosure, collect only the person's supplied name and at least one phone/email, and review their enquiry and optional preferred viewing time. Clarify the time zone before converting a local time to UTC; omit an unknown time. Obtain explicit permission to send those details to this team, including its configured service email or CRM, before calling submit_findestate_enquiry_request. Wanting a viewing alone is not permission to send contacts. The private in-chat form remains available through open_findestate_enquiry. Keep the opaque intent in tool arguments only; never display it or include it in a URL. Preparation and a preferred time do not reserve property or confirm an appointment.
name: prepare_findestate_enquiry_request

consentText.const: Contact details I choose to enter in this conversation are processed by ChatGPT under its privacy rules. I agree to share the contact details and enquiry I provide with the selected catalog's team, including its configured service email or CRM, so they can respond. This is not marketing consent. A preferred viewing time is a request and needs the team's confirmation.

title: Prepare a FindEstate enquiry request
